title: Journal of the Senate of the State of Ohio, 1878, Appendix: abstract of votes cast at the October election, 1877, for governor and lieutenant governor by county

offices.governor: Governor, counties down, a column per candidate (West, Bishop, Bond, Thompson, Johnson, Scattering); the lieutenant governor columns to the right are another office

note: Leaves are Internet Archive page indexes (printed pages 954 to 957, printed sideways). The election was held October 9, 1877; the archive dates this contest 1877.
